description: Installation of low level extraction to the rear, and new shopfront.

application_details.lead_developer_company_name: LBRuT Non-Comm Env Health Noise Issues

decision_conditions:
Unfortunately, the error with the site address renders this application invalid, all of the documents as listed below refer to the incorrect application site and therefore the council have consulted on the incorrect site address, this includes all internal consultees, neighbours and public site notice and advert. In line with national legislation will need to re-register and re-consult once corrected documentation has been received from yourselves. Please correct the following documentation and email items. 

Application Form
CIL Form
Site Location Plan
Heritage Statement
Fire Safety Statement
Noise Impact Assessment
Ventilation Strategy and Sound Report
Existing and Proposed Drawings

In addition to the above, I also draw your attention to our 'Conservation and Design' (DAS) team's comments, which you should seek to address when amending the documentation: 

DAS Comments
'The applicants propose to replace the existing shopfront to this property. The proposed shopfront divides the shopfront into two equal shop fronts with a slim centre glazing bar. It is unlikely that this shopfront was divided up in the same way as the adjacent shopfronts. However, the original and the existing shopfront do have the same depth between the fascia and the stallriser. Therefore, the proposed shopfront should reflect the other shopfronts in this important group so that the top of the glazed element aligns with the adjacent shop fronts.

The proposed stallriser seems less deep than the existing one. The depth of the stallriser should align with the adjacent shopfronts which are part of the same group of properties. 

Do the applicants need to alter the stallriser as it may be stone? If this is so it would be desirable to remove the paint to discover the original finish.

As regards the rear elevation, the applicants propose to block up the existing window and install an air out vent. Where an original window is being blocked up it is normal to leave as a dummy window and only infill leaving a recess to acknowledge the original window opening.'
